cases.description: Two-column academic paper (arXiv 2609.20519): auto-routed rigid; figures, tables and formulas must survive. One figure-legend fragment stays source: the mock echo cannot fit its narrow box at any drawn size (see corpus/README.md).

Academic paper (arXiv 2608.25512): figures/tables survive; math/algorithm debris is preserved, everything else translated. A handful of source-line fragments (a 12-31pt-wide box holding one line of a formula-bearing line) cannot hold the mock echo at any drawn size and stay source.

Math-heavy paper (arXiv 2609.22978): formulas must survive, not shatter. One block is quarantined: the mock echo cannot produce $...$ inline math, so a math-bearing block trips the undelimited-math rule in every rehearsal (see corpus/README.md).

Book chapter (prose): reflow must deliver the text. One block is quarantined: the mock echo cannot produce $...$ inline math, so a math-bearing block trips the undelimited-math rule in every rehearsal (see corpus/README.md).

Two-column paper (arXiv 2606.23344, RT-DocLayout): the document that exposed every gate false positive and the two semantic losses fixed in this round — a reference list without numbers, a table whose stacked cells fused, a URL that swallowed the word after it. Tables, formulas and the 54-entry bibliography must all survive.
